explanation.value: Indentation of print("+") was lost in the source PDF. Assuming it sits at the i-loop level, each i emits one '-' line and one '+' line = 10 lines. If print("+") is inside the j-loop instead, the answer is 30. Confirmed = official answer key (new- format QIM/QIA4 export, 2025 Oct26).
